title: sub: p1-structured-output
creator: codex
notes: S1 in progress on feat/p1d-structured-output. Ticket scope: the main chain moves to provider-native structured output + Pydantic schema + semantic validator + validation-error retry; _parse_json_response_impl becomes a legacy fallback; ContentPlan and friends get typed. Reconnaissance (2026-09-15): 25 _parse_json_response call sites across 13 agents, a second copy in services/llm_enrichment.py, zero with_structured_output anywhere, and three definitions of the same concept (api/generated Pydantic contract, state TypedDict, agent-side dicts). Production routes 13/15 TaskTypes to astron-code-latest (XUNFEI) and 4 of the 6 providers are OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so native structured-output support cannot be verified offline. Confirmed with the user before implementing: (1) capability declaration + degradation chain rather than all-native, (2) a new LLM-facing output model with normalisation rather than reusing the generated contract (too strict for a model: AwareDatetime / hex pattern / StrictStr would fail legal output), (3) this slice = scaffolding + one pilot (content_strategist ContentPlan). Red lines: no prompt text change (P1b snapshot stays at 0 drift), no edits under api/generated, no new dependency, _parse_json_response behaviour untouched. S1 landed on feat/p1d-structured-output (2026-09-15). Shipped: structured.py (capability declaration per provider, overridable via XHS_STRUCTURED_MODE_<PROVIDER>; degradation_path; validate_output doing schema only; StructuredOutputError), outputs.py (permissive ContentPlanOutput + normalize_content_plan), base.py _llm_structured / _structured_call / _llm_ainvoke(runnable, model_kwargs, raw unwrap), and the content_strategist pilot migration. Four things only surfaced once it ran: (1) the old drift guard nudged once and then accepted, so plumbing it through a fail-fast chain silently promoted an advisory check to a hard requirement -> added accept_last_valid (malformed payloads are still never returned; only validator refusals can be); (2) validate_output collapsed schema failure and validator refusal into one return value, which is the same trap -> it now does schema only and the caller runs the validator; (3) the NATIVE level was dead, because with_structured_output returns a validated instance and validate_output demanded a dict -> it now accepts a mapping or an instance of output_model; (4) the leniency branches in outputs.py were unreachable behind list[str] fields, and a model writing "a、b" for key_points would have been iterated character by character -> shape leniency moved into the model via mode=before validators and _as_list. Also fixed an existing defect found on the way: builder.py's content_strategist conditional edge omitted "__end__" from its path map while content_strategist_router returns it from its terminal guard, so any content_strategist failure crashed the graph with KeyError: '__end__' (fixed, plus tests/unit/graph/test_conditional_edge_wiring.py which compares every router's Literal return set against its path map both ways). Gates: pytest 2868 passed / 3 skipped, ruff check + format clean (491 files), mypy clean (199 files), P1b baseline drift 0, tool_runtime_gate OK. S2a landed on feat/p1d-s2a-scout-agents (2026-09-15). Scout agents first: trend_scout (SCOUTING -> XUNFEI -> PROMPTED) and blogger_scout (MOCK_GEN -> DEEPSEEK -> JSON_OBJECT), which between them cover both non-native levels and are the only two agents on the JSON_OBJECT level. Shipped: outputs.py (7 new models for TrendData / BloggerProfile plus normalize_trend_data / normalize_blogger_candidates, helpers _as_float dropping the percent sign without rescaling, _as_int reading "5万"/"1.2w"/"3k", _topic_text settling the topic/title/name/keyword aliases once), structured.py (render_schema_instructions recursing into nested models once each, _type_label learning Any and Optional[X]), both agents migrated onto _llm_structured, and _retry_mock_with_explicit_json deleted (36 lines, no test referenced it, and the facility retries with a correction on its own). Three things only surfaced once it ran: (1) THE EXPENSIVE ONE — _llm_structured treated "could not ask" as "answered badly": a call that raised was recorded as "this level is unusable" and the chain degraded, so a complete LLM outage became empty trends with a success status, taking 07-07's error state and P1a-S2's failed perf entries with it and turning three test_stateful_retry E2E tests red. Judged class (b) — a real regression — and fixed in the facility: when the chain is exhausted and not one level ever answered, the original exception is raised instead of StructuredOutputError. The distinction carries weight because StructuredOutputError is what callers convert into a business fallback ("no trends this time"), and an outage that borrows that meaning is an outage nobody retries. (2) _parse_json_response's failure payload {"raw_content": ...} now PASSES the schema (every field has a default, extras are ignored), so keeping the model's text out of state rests on the output model declaring every key rather than on the chain refusing it — both mechanisms hold, and the assertion pins the property rather than one mechanism. (3) the schema hint did not spell out nested models, which is exactly the shape the scouts return; added the recursion and fixed Optional[X] being labelled "string" — with expand-once that mislabel has no compensating expansion. Pre-existing defects found on the way: trending_notes and market_saturation are read by blogger_scout and content_strategist but were never declared on TrendData (now modelled, with a test pinning the remaining gap to exactly those two keys); and six test_blogger_scout cases used AsyncMock() as the model, whose bind() returns an un-awaited coroutine, so the JSON_OBJECT level died with AttributeError and the chain silently degraded to PROMPTED — green tests that never ran the level production uses (replaced with a real double plus a bound == [{"response_format": {"type": "json_object"}}] assertion). Gates: pytest 2910 passed / 3 skipped, ruff check + format clean (493 files), mypy clean (199 files), P1b baseline drift 0, tool_runtime_gate OK.
